quest.title: Get a Drink at Least!
quest.description: The boss of the café, Arouet, is busy at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Chatelet just ordered a <color=#00E1FFFF>Latte</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: First, you'll need to mix <color=#00E1FFFF>one portion of coffee extract and milk each</color> completely, before capping it off with <color=#00E1FFFF>a serving of milk foam</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Milk foam is a special ingredient we've got here. Making it involves preparing another serving of milk, washing and drying this tube here at the coffee machine...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Before stabbing the tube into the milk at this angle... Uh, you know what, I'll just help you make that. It's a bit much to ask a beginner to make the foam...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Ah, you don't have to make coffee for any of our guests today.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: You've helped out a lot at the store, and your brewing skills have been getting better by the day. To be honest, I'd say you're qualified to be an official coffee maker.

choices.text: So I've been unofficial all this time?

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Ah, I'm afraid we'll have to talk about the trouble that Mr. Macadell brought us.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: This fellow from the Palais has absolutely no knowledge about coffee, but he certainly is a master at making something out of nothing.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: He has requested that all cafés implement a system he designed, and that we accept the Palais Mermonia's supervision.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: To be more specific, the abilities of all employed coffee makers must be "assessed," and assigned a level from 1 to 5.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: This assessment not only includes a 27-page exam, but also a series of practical tests, ranging from basic to advanced.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Once that process is complete, Mr. Macadell and his fellow make-work specialists will distribute level certificates to the coffee makers.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Someone with a certificate is "official," and the opposite is true of those without.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And what's the purpose of said certificate?

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: As far as I and others in this line can see, not much, at least with regard to brewing coffee.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: It will not make someone's brew tasty or terrible, nor will it affect the maker's ability to make coffee.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: What it does do, however, is allow Mr. Macadell to set up a Coffee Management Office — under his personal banner again, no less — with a whole bunch of subordinates under him.

choices.text: So... will I need to take said exam?

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: What? No, no, no. In truth, Mr. Macadell's system was suspended not five months into its implementation.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: According to his so-called testing standards, only a handful of people in all Fontaine would count as certified coffee makers.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: I mean, we all know this is a meaningless title, but the customers don't.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: If they hear that a café employs an uncertified coffee maker, then they might also think the café is an unlicensed establishment.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: The café owners who took losses as a result were very displeased.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: They banded together to send Mr. Macadell's office advisory letters... I think it came up to three a week.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: After a "sincere and frank discussion," they came to an agreement all parties were satisfied with.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: The assessment plan proposed by Mr. Macadell would not change, nor would the coffee maker designations.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: But the exam and the standard answers would be sent to all the various shop owners, with the practical operation assessment also being in their hands.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: After evaluating a coffee maker, the owners must also write an evaluative description and a promissory letter, before sending those to the Palais Mermonia.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Finally, the Coffee Management Office will then send the certification to the coffee maker in question.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Macadell has recently announced that the issuing of all physical certificates will be temporarily slowed to decrease office spending — certified coffee makers merely need to register with them in person.

choices.text: Wait, then this certification is completely pointless!

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Well, those gentlemen at the Palais Mermonia specialize in exactly these things. But don't you worry — I know what to do with the paper exam.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: However, according to my own house rules, any official coffee maker must be able to create their own special blend of coffee before they can take up the title.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Come. Here are some ingredients that have never been used in brewing coffee — Marcotte, Rainbow Rose, and Lumidouce Bell.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Pick one — I'd like to see what new coffee blend you'll be able to come up with.

choices.text: I'll go with Marcotte.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Hmm, an interesting thought — to use this plant to make coffee. Very daring indeed.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Good. I'll help you process the ingredients, and then you can start.

choices.text: Let's do Rainbow Rose.
I pick Lumidouce Bell.
Well, you sure went on a long tangent...
I'm not exactly an exam expert.
There are unofficial coffee makers?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Very good. Then let's begin. If you have any questions, feel free to ask me again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (It's time to add the coffee brew's ingredients in...)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The coffee is brewed in a precise and efficient manner...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: What stunning flavor, and what a rich aroma... Let me have a taste...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Perfection! This flavor is perfect — you're a natural!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Surely you exaggerate...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Come now! It is precisely that unnecessary humility that has kept your talent buried. I'm sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Congratulations! From now on, you're a proper coffee maker!

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Right, please take this cup, then. House rules state that every proper coffee maker must have their very own coffee cup.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: This cup will remain in the store — just use it whenever you stop by for a coffee.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Once I'm ready, I'll talk to dear Mr. Macadell at the Coffee Management Office to have you noted down as an official coffee maker.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Let's hope he's amenable... Hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Hmm... There's something not quite right about this Latte...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: First, you'll need to mix <color=#00E1FFFF>one portion of coffee extract</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>one portion of milk</color> together completely.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: After that, you need to cap it off with <color=#00E1FFFF>a serving of milk foam</color>... which I've already prepared for you. It's over there.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Please try it again.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Your technique's all over the place today... Did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: It's alright. Leave the brewing to me this time.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Arouet starts brewing the coffee...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Alright, please bring this to our customers...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: This flavor is excellent — one might even call it perfect. Bring it to our customer as soon as possible. I'm sure she'll enjoy it!

talks.objective: Give the coffee to Officer Menthe
Give the coffee to Officer Menthe

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Excellent! Our customers are most satisfied with your work. You do have a gift, if I do say so myself.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: If you have time in the future, please do come around more often — you'll be welcome as a guest and a coffee maker both.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: If you'll let me add my two Mora, I'd say that should you put in the work, it's only a matter of time before you become truly great at this.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Hello, welcome! What would you like to have?

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Name the flavor you favor, then find a seat — coffee to savor will be with you in a beat.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: But a word to the wise — best to keep your distance from the other customers while you find your spot.

choices.text: So "one person, one table" is your style?

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Well, I wouldn't say so. On the contrary, those who drink coffee are dying to unburden themselves to a companion — if they were to get hold of you, you'd be here all day.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You sound like you're describing drunkards...

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: And would you believe me if I said that drunkards would be easier to handle? Call the police on them, and they'll sober up right away.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: But clarity is what the chatty gentlepeople here have in spades — and before one of you concedes, not even fists will shut their mouths.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: And that's why I advise you to keep your distance, or your early impression of our dear Fontaine may go ill.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And why are they like... this?

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Now, if you were to ask me... Why, I'd say our coffee is so delicious that our customers can't help but slowly savor every sip. They could never bear to down it in one go!

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Then, unable to withstand the void created in their souls by the lack of our wondrous brew, they must find someone to speak to and pass the time... I jest, of course.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: A café is like a tavern — it is a place to relax. After a long day of work, few have any lack of complaints about how their day went, and such.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Of course, I have little doubt that drinking wine is more effective than coffee — yet it comes with a risk that its counterpart lacks...

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: If one takes to having a drink to go with any given complaint, one will be liable to drink too much and lose one's wits.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That does go pretty badly, yes...

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Indeed. I once met someone from the Palais Mermonia. He's usually a polite, patient, and meticulous fellow.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: One day, he had too much to drink, and asserted that he was an apple tree, even shouting that someone had uprooted him and stripped him of his bark... Of course, he'd taken those clothes off himself.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: And then he searched high and low for tree pits, proclaiming loudly that he must return to the soil, else wither and perish.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Fortunately, some quick-thinking fellow had us dig a pit right there, and when we were done, we pointed at it and hollered "What's this? We're missing an apple tree over here!"

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Hearing that, Mr. Apple Tree leaped into the trench like one hearing a siren, and even urged us to pile some soil atop him... In the end, he fell asleep with half his body still sticking out of the earth.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Thus was peace restored... Though the person who came up with the idea did get a little unlucky...

choices.text: How so?

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Well, trouble was that he believed himself a shovel, and dug using his head while we were moving the soil.

choices.text: Do you have... other stories?

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: *cough* Well, you're a curious sort — I suppose you'd like to have the hearsay without the hassle?

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: As it happens, we're short-staffed at present, so if you'd be willing to help brew some coffee, I can take you on as a temporary employee.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: In that way, I'll have my succor, and you'll have your stories — and you can leave anytime. How does that sound?

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: You'll be paid of course — to your satisfaction, that I guarantee.

choices.text: Sure, but...

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: That's no issue, I'll teach you. I believe that with your powers of comprehension, brewing coffee will be little challenge — and mind you, I'm not a bad judge of character.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Let me see...

choices.text: I'm not very good at making coffee...
You seem to have a great deal of stories to tell...
He sounds like a smart cookie to me.
Is everyone here a solo drinker?

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Ready to start blending some coffee?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other matters to attend to at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Just tell me once you're ready. If you have any questions, just ask away.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: It seems that your calm's been disturbed. Your technique is a jumble, and no mistake.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: It's alright, it happens to the best of us. Learn to relax — this is a cup of coffee, not life and death.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Believe me, you have talent, you just need to stay calm, and you'll do fantastic work.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Ah, you're finally here. I've been hanging on by a thread here, just so you know! Come, get behind the counter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lots of customers, I presume?

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Oh, you bet, and unexpectedly so! We haven't had an empty seat since the day you came to help out.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: I mean, what did I tell you? You're a natural! If you're willing, you can just stay here and help me.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: If things go well, I might even be able to help you open a branch of your own!

choices.text: I've got other things I must do...

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Alright, alright, you busy bee. You were running like the wind last I saw you pass the store by — why, one would think you were being pursued, the way you ran!

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: But since you're here, I suppose that a slot's opened up?

choices.text: You could say that.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Wonderful. Let me see, then...

choices.text: Enough to brew up some coffee, anyway.
The Adventurers' Guild has loads of work waiting for me...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Officer Menthe seems to have something important to do. She's ordered a cup of <color=#00E1FFFF>Clarity Coffee</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: You need <color=#00E1FFFF>one portion of coffee and drinking water each</color>. Take the cup with coffee in it and pour the water in, and you're done. Easy peasy, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Now, I can't say I'm fond of this rather flippant way of making coffee, what with it ignoring flavor and all...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: But it is very quick, and it only requires coffee extract and water. There's no milk or any other ingredients, so its energizing effects are very apparent...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Which makes it perfect for someone who's constantly having to power through physical and mental exhaustion at work every day.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: *sigh* That Officer Menthe...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Chatelet seems to be in a good mood today. She's ordered <color=#00E1FFFF>a cup of Milk Coffee</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: You'll need <color=#00E1FFFF>one portion of coffee extract</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>milk</color> each. After mixing the two, you'll need to add some <color=#00E1FFFF>cream</color> over the top to finish it up.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Have you tried our specially-made cream? It smells really good, is as soft as a cloud, and isn't too sweet...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, don't worry, you won't have to make any yourself — just use the stock we have in the store. I was just introducing it to you, that's all...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Officer Menthe appears to have encountered something troublesome... She's ordered an <color=#00E1FFFF>Espresso</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: You just need to mix these <color=#00E1FFFF>two portions of coffee</color> together to make it, and add some dessert on the side. As I recall, she's fond of cakes.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: *sigh* She seems more tired than ever...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Hmm... There's something off about this Clarity Coffee...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: You need <color=#00E1FFFF>one portion of coffee</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>drinking water</color> each. Take the cup with coffee in it and pour the water in, and you're done.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Please try it again.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Hmm... There's something not quite right about this Milk Coffee...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: You'll need <color=#00E1FFFF>one portion of coffee extract</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>milk</color> each to make it. Finally, after mixing the two, you'll need to add some <color=#00E1FFFF>cream</color> over the top to finish it up.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Please try it again.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Hmm... There's something odd about this Espresso...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: You just need to mix these <color=#00E1FFFF>two portions of coffee</color> together, and you're done.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Please try it again.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Have you finished making the coffee?

choices.text: Remind me about how to make Lattes again...

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: First, you'll need to mix <color=#00E1FFFF>one portion of coffee extract</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>one portion of milk</color> together completely.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: After that, you need to cap it off with <color=#00E1FFFF>a serving of milk foam</color>... which I've already prepared for you. It's over there.

choices.text: See you.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: I'm looking forward to the coffee that you'll make.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Is something the matter?

choices.text: Remind me how to make Clarity Coffee again.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: You need <color=#00E1FFFF>one portion of coffee and drinking water each</color>. Take the cup with coffee in it and pour the water in, and you're done. Easy-peasy.

choices.text: See you.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: I'm looking forward to the coffee that you'll make.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: What can I do for you?

choices.text: Could you go over the method for making Milk Coffee...

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: You'll need <color=#00E1FFFF>one portion of coffee extract</color> and <color=#00E1FFFF>milk</color> each. After mixing the two, you'll need to add some <color=#00E1FFFF>cream</color> over the top to finish it up.

choices.text: See you.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: I'm looking forward to the coffee that you'll make.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: What can I do for you?

choices.text: Could you run me through the method of making Espresso again...

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: You just need to mix these <color=#00E1FFFF>two portions of coffee</color> together — and if Officer Menthe comes along, pair it with a cake.

choices.text: See you.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: I'm looking forward to the coffee that you'll make.

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: *sigh* Couldn't Arouet say a little less for once...

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: There's still a lot to do... Gotta keep it together...

dialogues.speaker: Chatelet
dialogues.text: Ooh, this coffee will definitely be great!

dialogues.speaker: Menthe
dialogues.text: Keep it together... Stay awake... Keep it together...
